+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m39myep7qd182qv5m9etgkds
+  text: |-
+    Research:
+    - `SessionSidecar` fields are internal. The live suites decode a subset of `session.json` (slot, agentSpawn, configuration.instructions). `SessionSidecar.AgentSpawn` is public.
+    - `TranscriptEvent` is public and Codable. `operationEvents` reads the posts: the journal writes a `.toolOutput` entry at the post, and the next turn writes the same event on its `.prompt` entry. Thus "the next turn reads it" is a `.prompt` event with the token.
+    - `check agent` and `cancel agent` refuse a run of another caller. A host call (no ToolContext) is caller nil. Thus: the full-circle check comes from the root model; the cancel test starts and cancels through host calls of the agents tool (caller nil).
+    - The generation gate is held for the whole turn, also during a tool call. A tool that waits in one suite can block a run of another suite. Swift Testing runs top-level suites in parallel, thus all live suites go under one serialized parent suite.
+    - Overlap: a barrier tool on each slot. Each call waits for the other call. With one shared gate, the second call cannot come, and the barrier times out.
+    - Live edit: the old run (flash) waits in a hold tool. The edit moves the agent to standard and changes the body. The new run finishes first; then the test opens the hold.

+  text: |-
+    What did not work (do not repeat):
+    - A root model call of `check agent` after the delivery turn: Qwen3-4B answered from memory and made no call (1 of 3 runs). Now the test keeps the `ToolContext` of the `start agent` call (`LiveAgentsToolProbe`) and calls `check agent` in that context with `ToolContext.$current.withValue`.

+    - The post op is the tool name (`agents`), not `start agent`: `ToolContext` stamps a plain tool with its name. The nested test joins by correlation id and by the start answer that names the run id.
+    - Swift Testing runs top-level suites in parallel. Each live suite, `LiveSourcesTests` too, is now nested under the serialized parent `LiveSuites`.
